title: Baldur's Gate 3
smallDescription: Gather your party and return to the Forgotten Realms in a tale of fellowship and betrayal, sacrifice and survival.

features.title: Gather Your Party
features.description: Choose from 12 classes and 11 races, and build relationships that can blossom into romances or crumble into rivalries as you shape your legend.

features.title: A World Full of Choices
features.description: Every decision carries weight. Your choices ripple through the story, shaping the world of Faerûn and deciding the fate of millions.

features.title: Turn-Based Tactical Combat
features.description: Harness the power of Divinity 5e rules in strategic, deeply satisfying combat. Use the environment, spells, and your party's skills to outwit your enemies.

features.title: Online & Local Co-op
features.description: Play the full game alone or with up to 3 friends. Each player controls their own character and makes their own decisions, creating diverging stories that can be reconciled.

reviews.comment: The most immersive RPG experience I have ever had. Every playthrough feels completely different.
Larian Studios outdid themselves. Game of the decade, possibly ever.

title: Elden Ring
smallDescription: Rise, Tarnished, and be guided by grace to brandish the power of the Elden Ring and become an Elden Lord in the Lands Between.

features.title: A Vast World Full of Excitement
features.description: A rich interactive fantasy world built on a foundation of mythologies supervised by Hidetaka Miyazaki and George R.R. Martin.

features.title: Create Your Own Character
features.description: In addition to customizing your character's appearance, you can freely combine weapons, armor pieces, and magic to create your own unique build.

features.title: An Epic Drama Born from a Myth
features.description: A multilayered story told in fragments, where each player discovers new depths with every playthrough.

features.title: Unique Online Play
features.description: In addition to multiplayer, where you can directly connect with other players and travel together, the game supports a unique asynchronous online element.

reviews.comment: FromSoftware's magnum opus. The open world design is revolutionary for the souls genre.
Incredible game, but Shadow of the Erdtree DLC pushes it to perfection.

title: Cyberpunk 2077
smallDescription: Cyberpunk 2077 is an open-world, action-adventure RPG set in the megalopolis of Night City, where you play as V, a mercenary outlaw going after a one-of-a-kind implant.

features.title: Night City — A World of Endless Possibilities
features.description: Night City is packed with things to do and places to visit. You can take on quests, explore districts, infiltrate corpo compounds, or just cruise the neon-lit streets.

features.title: Play Your Way
features.description: Go in guns blazing, hack your way through security systems, or talk your way out of trouble. Your build, your playstyle.

features.title: A Story of Survival
features.description: Become V, a mercenary with a mysterious chip that may give immortality but also threatens to erase your identity.

features.title: Phantom Liberty Expansion
features.description: A spy-thriller adventure in Dogtown with Idris Elba, featuring new gameplay systems, weapons, and a brand new district to explore.

reviews.comment: After all the patches and Phantom Liberty, this is one of the best RPGs ever made.
Rough launch but the 2.0 update transformed this game entirely. Story is phenomenal.

title: Hogwarts Legacy
smallDescription: Experience Hogwarts in the 1800s. Your character is a student who holds the key to an ancient secret that threatens to tear the wizarding world apart.

features.title: Live the Unwritten
features.description: Be at the center of your own adventure in the wizarding world. Discover a dangerous secret that predates the events of the books.

features.title: Explore a Stunning Open World
features.description: Discover Hogwarts castle in extraordinary detail, from secret passages to ancient dungeons, plus explore the surrounding Highlands.

features.title: Master Magical Skills
features.description: Develop your character's abilities by mastering spells, brewing potions, growing plants, and taming magical beasts.

features.title: Choose Your Path
features.description: Decisions you make as a student will affect your journey, the alliances you form, and ultimately the fate of the wizarding world.

reviews.comment: Truly the Harry Potter game fans have been waiting for. The castle detail is mind-blowing.
Great open world RPG set in a beautifully crafted wizarding world. Combat feels satisfying.

title: Resident Evil 4 Remake
smallDescription: Survival is just the beginning. Survival horror reimagined for 2023 — Leon S. Kennedy must rescue the President's kidnapped daughter.

features.title: A Reimagined Classic
features.description: The beloved classic is completely rebuilt from the ground up with modernized gameplay and a reimagined storyline.

features.title: Intense Survival Horror
features.description: Manage your resources carefully and adapt your strategy in real time as terrifying enemies relentlessly pursue you.

features.title: Vividly Detailed Graphics
features.description: Experience the world of Resident Evil 4 like never before with stunning visuals powered by the RE Engine.

features.title: Expanded Story and Characters
features.description: A deeper look into Leon and Ashley's relationship with additional scenes, expanded lore, and fully voiced dialogue.

reviews.comment: The perfect remake. Everything that made the original great, elevated to modern standards.
Capcom absolutely nailed it. Best survival horror game in years.

title: Alan Wake 2
smallDescription: Ritualistic murders in a small town. An FBI agent looking for answers, and a writer trapped in a terrifying nightmare world.

features.title: Two Intertwined Storylines
features.description: Play as FBI agent Saga Anderson hunting a killer in the real world, and as Alan Wake trying to write his way out of the Dark Place.

features.title: A Living Nightmare
features.description: Alan Wake 2 is a psychological thriller where the lines between fiction and reality blur in terrifying ways.

features.title: Remedy's Signature Storytelling
features.description: Award-winning narrative design combined with stunning next-gen visuals and live-action sequences.

features.title: Survival Horror Gameplay
features.description: Manage light and darkness, scavenge for resources, and use environmental hazards to survive monstrous encounters.

reviews.comment: A masterpiece of storytelling and atmosphere. Remedy has done it again.
Visually stunning and narratively bold. One of the most unique games I have ever played.

title: Marvel's Spider-Man 2
smallDescription: Spider-Men Peter Parker and Miles Morales return for an exciting new adventure, facing Venom and Kraven the Hunter in a massive open-world New York City.

features.title: Two Spider-Men, One City
features.description: Seamlessly switch between Peter Parker and Miles Morales, each with their own unique abilities and skill trees.

features.title: The Symbiote Threat
features.description: Experience the transformation as Peter bonds with the symbiote suit, gaining incredible power at a terrible cost.

features.title: Bigger New York City
features.description: Explore a Manhattan twice the size of any previous game in the franchise, including new boroughs and traversal mechanics.

features.title: Marvel-Grade Storytelling
features.description: A cinematic narrative featuring iconic villains Venom and Kraven the Hunter, with breathtaking PS5-exclusive visuals.

reviews.comment: Insomniac keeps raising the bar. Best superhero game of this generation.
The Venom storyline is phenomenal. Miles and Peter have incredible chemistry.

title: God of War Ragnarök
smallDescription: Join Kratos and Atreus on a mythic journey for answers before the prophesied battle that will end the world.

features.title: The Nine Realms Await
features.description: Embark on a mythic journey to all Nine Realms of Norse mythology, from the icy peaks of Midgard to the fiery depths of Muspelheim.

features.title: Evolving Kratos
features.description: Witness Kratos grow from a god of war into a reluctant father, navigating the demands of family and the weight of a prophecy.

features.title: Epic Combat Refined
features.description: Master the Leviathan Axe, the Blades of Chaos, and new abilities to fight gods, monsters, and mythological creatures.

features.title: A Father and Son Story
features.description: Atreus comes into his own in this emotionally charged conclusion to the Norse saga, demanding answers Kratos is unwilling to give.

reviews.comment: A deeply emotional and thrilling conclusion to the Norse saga. Surpassed the original in every way.
The story is breathtaking. Kratos and Atreus's relationship is the heart of one of gaming's greatest narratives.

title: Diablo IV
smallDescription: Join the eternal war between Heaven and Hell. Lilith has returned to Sanctuary, and only the most steadfast of heroes can hold in the face of darkness.

features.title: Return to Darkness
features.description: The darkest, most expansive Diablo experience ever created. Explore an enormous open world filled with over 140 dungeons.

features.title: Five Mighty Classes
features.description: Choose from Barbarian, Sorceress, Druid, Rogue, and Necromancer, each with deep customization and playstyle options.

features.title: Endless Endgame
features.description: Push into Nightmare Dungeons, take on World Bosses, earn Season rewards, and keep min-maxing your perfect build.

features.title: Cross-Platform Co-op
features.description: Play with up to 4 friends across all platforms with full cross-play and cross-progression support.

reviews.comment: Incredible atmosphere and great loot loop. Season content has greatly improved the endgame.
The Necromancer class is the most satisfying to play. Graphics are stunning.

title: Forza Horizon 5
smallDescription: Your Ultimate Horizon Adventure awaits! Explore the vibrant open world landscapes of Mexico with limitless, fun driving action in hundreds of the world's greatest cars.

features.title: Mexico: The Greatest Horizon Yet
features.description: Explore the largest and most diverse Horizon map ever built, from lush jungle to arid desert, volcanic highlands to golden beaches.

features.title: Hundreds of Cars
features.description: Choose from over 500 cars and drive them all in gorgeous 4K detail with ray tracing support on PC and Xbox Series X.

features.title: Dynamic Seasons
features.description: Experience the world transform with seasonal content updates — every week brings new events, rewards, and challenges.

features.title: Multiplayer & Co-op
features.description: Race, explore, and create together with friends in online multiplayer, from ranked racing to open convoy exploration.

reviews.comment: The best open-world racing game ever made. Mexico is a gorgeous playground.
Incredible car variety and stunning visuals. Seasonal events keep me coming back every week.

title: Cities: Skylines II
smallDescription: Build and manage the city of your dreams. Create the most realistic and complex cities in any city-building game to date.

features.title: City Building Evolved
features.description: A fully realized transport network, an active economy, and detailed city simulations that react to your every decision.

features.title: Living Cities
features.description: Every citizen has a simulated life — jobs, commutes, homes, and leisure — creating a truly living urban environment.

features.title: Unprecedented Scale
features.description: Build cities up to 159 sq. km in size, across diverse map tiles including farmland, coastlines, and mountain ranges.

features.title: Deep Economy System
features.description: Balance budgets, manage city services, set policies, and navigate the complex economics of a growing metropolis.

reviews.comment: The simulation depth is unmatched. It needs optimization patches but the foundation is phenomenal.
Great concept with deep systems, but performance issues at launch were disappointing. Getting better with updates.

title: Hollow Knight: Silksong
smallDescription: Hornet, princess-protector of Hallownest, is captured and taken to a vast kingdom above. She must battle her way through treacherous enemies and discover the secrets of this new world.

features.title: A New Hero, A New Kingdom
features.description: Play as Hornet, sewing-needle in hand, in an enormous new kingdom filled with silk, traps, and dangerous creatures.

features.title: 150+ New Enemies and Bosses
features.description: Face an enormous cast of new enemies and epic boss encounters across a beautiful hand-drawn world.

features.title: Metroidvania Perfected
features.description: Discover upgrades, unlock abilities, and explore interconnected zones filled with secrets and lore.

features.title: Handcrafted Artistry
features.description: Every frame hand-animated, every room hand-painted. A visual and auditory masterpiece from Team Cherry.

reviews.comment: Worth every year of waiting. Hornet is a fantastic protagonist and the gameplay is sublime.
Team Cherry did the impossible — they made a sequel that surpasses the original.

title: Stardew Valley
smallDescription: You've inherited your grandfather's old farm plot in Stardew Valley. Armed with hand-me-down tools and a few coins, you set out to begin your new life.

features.title: Build the Farm of Your Dreams
features.description: Clear land, grow crops, raise animals, and build the perfect farm across multiple seasons with tons of variety.

features.title: A Thriving Community
features.description: Befriend the 30+ unique villagers of Pelican Town, complete quests, and even find romance.

features.title: Explore the Mines
features.description: Venture into procedurally generated mines filled with monsters, treasure, and resources to craft powerful tools.

features.title: Online Multiplayer
features.description: Work the land together with up to 3 other players in co-op farm mode — share chores, build together, and celebrate the seasons.

reviews.comment: One of the most relaxing and rewarding games ever created. A masterclass in cozy game design.
500 hours in and still discovering new things. ConcernedApe continues to add free content.

title: Celeste
smallDescription: Help Madeline survive her inner demons on her journey to the top of Celeste Mountain in this challenging but rewarding precision platformer.

features.title: A Story About Mental Health
features.description: Explore a heartfelt narrative about anxiety and self-doubt through Madeline's challenging mountain climb.

features.title: Precision Platforming Excellence
features.description: 700+ handcrafted screens of tight, responsive platforming with an Assist Mode for players of all skill levels.

features.title: Award-Winning Soundtrack
features.description: A gorgeous original score by Lena Raine that shifts dynamically to match Madeline's emotional state.

features.title: Hidden Depths
features.description: Discover B-Sides, C-Sides, and the insanely challenging Chapter 9 for players who want to truly push their limits.

reviews.comment: The perfect platformer. Challenging but always fair, with one of the most touching stories in gaming.
This game helped me understand my own anxiety. A masterpiece in every way.

title: Dead by Daylight
smallDescription: A multiplayer action horror game where one player is the Killer and the others are Survivors trying to escape. Based on iconic horror franchises.

features.title: 1 vs 4 Asymmetric Horror
features.description: One player controls an iconic Killer while four Survivors scramble to repair generators and escape — tense, terrifying fun.

features.title: Iconic Horror Icons
features.description: Play as or against licensed killers including Michael Myers, Freddy Krueger, Ghostface, Pyramid Head, and many more.

features.title: Constant New Content
features.description: Regular chapter updates bring new Killers, Survivors, maps, and gameplay mechanics to keep every match fresh.

features.title: Cross-Platform Play
features.description: Play with friends across all platforms with cross-play support, expanding the player pool and reducing wait times.

reviews.comment: Best asymmetric horror game on the market. The licensed characters make every match thrilling.
Terrifying when you're losing, exhilarating when you escape. Addictive multiplayer horror.

title: Dave the Diver
smallDescription: A casual sushi restaurant management RPG adventure. Dive into the Blue Hole to catch fish by day, then manage a thriving sushi restaurant by night.

features.title: Dive, Catch, Serve
features.description: Explore the ever-changing Blue Hole during the day to catch exotic fish, then use them to craft dishes for your sushi restaurant at night.

features.title: Vast Underwater World
features.description: The Blue Hole changes depth and layout every dive, filled with hundreds of species of marine life and hidden dangers.

features.title: Restaurant Management
features.description: Hire staff, upgrade your kitchen, design the menu, and keep your customers happy in charming restaurant sim gameplay.

features.title: A Rich Story
features.description: Unravel the mysteries of the Blue Hole alongside a colorful cast of characters in a surprisingly deep narrative.

reviews.comment: The most charming surprise of 2023. I could not stop playing this addictive adventure.
Unique blend of genres that works incredibly well. Dave is one of gaming's most lovable protagonists.

title: Lies of P
smallDescription: Lies of P is a dark, punishing Soulslike where Pinocchio must traverse a crumbling Belle Époque city overrun by mad puppets.

features.title: A Dark Reimagining
features.description: Experience the classic tale of Pinocchio through a grim Soulslike lens, where your lies shape your fate.

features.title: Weapon Assembly System
features.description: Mix and match blade and handle parts from hundreds of weapons to create your perfect custom arsenal.

features.title: Lies Have Consequences
features.description: Choose to lie or tell the truth in key moments — your choices affect the story, items you receive, and the ending.

features.title: A Stunning Belle Époque World
features.description: Traverse the gorgeous and horrifying city of Krat, filled with gothic architecture and grotesque puppet enemies.

reviews.comment: Easily one of the best Soulslike games not made by FromSoftware. Incredible combat feel.
The weapon assembly system is genius. Visually gorgeous and brutally challenging.

title: Sea of Stars
smallDescription: A turn-based RPG inspired by the classics, telling the story of two Children of the Solstice who combine the power of the sun and moon to perform Eclipse Magic.

features.title: Classic JRPG Reinvented
features.description: A love letter to 16-bit RPGs with modernized turn-based combat, beautiful pixel art, and a sweeping musical score.

features.title: Timed Hit Combat
features.description: Hitting the button at the right moment enhances your attacks and blocks enemy damage — satisfying skill-based combat.

features.title: A World Worth Exploring
features.description: Sail across a vast world, solve puzzles, discover hidden ruins, and interact with a rich cast of characters.

features.title: Relic System
features.description: Customize difficulty and gameplay style with a flexible Relic system that lets you tailor the experience to your preferences.

reviews.comment: Captured the magic of classic JRPGs while feeling completely modern. The music is incredible.
Gorgeous pixel art and satisfying turn-based combat. One of the best indie RPGs in years.

title: Pacific Drive
smallDescription: Pacific Drive is a first-person driving survival game where your car is your only companion on a harrowing journey through the exclusion zone of the Pacific Northwest.

features.title: Your Car, Your Companion
features.description: Maintain, customize, and rely on your station wagon as you venture deeper into the dangerous Olympic Exclusion Zone.

features.title: Survival Driving
features.description: Scavenge resources, craft upgrades, and manage car systems on the fly as anomalies and dangers escalate around you.

features.title: A Mysterious Zone
features.description: Unravel the mysteries of the exclusion zone across eerily beautiful and procedurally arranged Pacific Northwest environments.

features.title: Deep Crafting Systems
features.description: Build and upgrade your garage between runs to prepare better equipment and unlock new tools for your journeys.

reviews.comment: One of the most unique survival games in years. The bond with your car is genuinely charming.
Atmospheric, tense, and full of mystery. The Pacific Northwest setting is hauntingly beautiful.

title: Hades
smallDescription: Defy the god of the dead as you hack and slash your way out of the Underworld. An award-winning roguelike action game from Supergiant Games.

features.title: A Story That Grows With Each Run
features.description: Every escape attempt reveals new story, dialogue, and character depth. The narrative never gets old across hundreds of runs.

features.title: Insanely Satisfying Combat
features.description: Choose from six weapons and dozens of boon combinations from Olympian gods to carve your perfect path through the Underworld.

features.title: A Cast of Legends
features.description: Meet and build relationships with a richly voiced cast of gods, monsters, and heroes from Greek mythology.

features.title: Stunning Art Direction
features.description: Greg Kasavin's writing and Jen Zee's distinctive art give Hades a visual identity unlike anything else in the genre.

reviews.comment: Supergiant's magnum opus. Every run is satisfying and the story is endlessly compelling.
The best roguelike ever made. Dialogue, art, music, and gameplay are all flawless.
